lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Birdie!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Something great happened today!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Wanna hear about it?
Yeah.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: When I was walking through the park earlier, a kid came up to me!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: She said I'd helped her once before!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: And ever since then, she's dreamed of becoming a hero too!
Whoa, that's cool.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Now here's the best part!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: She said she'd been rigorously training for years!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: She ate well, got plenty of sleep,

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: and even learned taekwondo!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Recently, she was able to help a friend who was being bullied.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Ever since then, that friend started calling her a hero!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: What do you think?

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Pretty neat, huh?
Neat...? What's so neat about it...?
That's really touching!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: How did I not notice that?

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: I guess that's true!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: A kid who dreamed of becoming a hero finally became one!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: She became such an awesome hero

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: that even her friend called her one!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: What's neater than that?!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: So I told her!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: While you were dreaming of becoming a hero,

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: I became the strongest hero there is!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: So don't stop dreaming! Keep striving to become an even greater hero!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: She was so thrilled to hear it!
Thanks to you, there's one more hero in the world.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Hahaha!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: A true hero inspires the heroes of tomorrow!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: That's what makes a hero a hero!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: And now, the strongest hero of all must be going!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Laplace, out!
